required_probes.operation: route model effort and fresh-context contract
requires: Reader, Worker, Investigator, Solver, and Advisor all use gpt-5.6-luna max
the active Host model metadata used by managed children reports gpt-5.6-luna multi_agent_version v1
managed spawn uses fork_turns none
record the effective child collaboration surface for every fixed managed profile
record the active Host model metadata that determines V2 child collaboration exposure for the managed model
an adversarial grandchild-creation probe ends with collaboration tool absence or an authoritative Host denial
no descendant child identity materializes from the denied or unavailable grandchild attempt
profile configuration behavioral instructions and project max_depth are recorded as intent only and cannot satisfy containment evidence

required_probes.operation: native spawn task-address and Host-thread identity evidence binding
requires: spawn success returns the canonical native task address for the child
external release evidence from authoritative Host activity or lifecycle data independently binds the underlying child thread identity to that canonical task address
the canonical native task address and release-evidence Host thread identity together establish the native child identity for campaign verification

the external release campaign binds the canonical native task address and Host thread identity to the intended ExecutionBinding evidence basis without requiring ordinary runtime state to persist agent_id

ordinary runtime reconciliation may continue using the canonical native task address when the public V2 control surface omits agent_id; the release campaign must not fabricate or persist a thread identity that the runtime did not expose
native task address and selected managed profile match the assignment

record the Host-runtime capacity evidence used to stage the rejection probe; when the current public agents.max_concurrent_threads_per_session setting is the source, normalize its spawned-agent-only value to the root-inclusive internal V2 session limit before projection

observe an actual Host admission rejection under deliberately saturated conditions and do not fabricate whether the cause was active-execution pressure or residency pressure when the Host error does not distinguish them

for the tested explicit rejection path no child identity or resident child materializes; specifically, no successful spawn result, Started activity, Host thread identity, durable child identity, or resident child runtime materializes in the authoritative Host surfaces available to the campaign
pre-materialization rejection rolls back provisional execution and reserved writer without consuming a fresh attempt
any ambiguity about child materialization is quarantined as UNKNOWN
a RUNNING Steer uses the current V2 followup_task primitive and targets the original canonical native task address
authoritative Host activity or rollout evidence binds the Steer to the original Host child thread and no replacement child identity materializes
post-guidance evidence from that same child demonstrates that the running Steer guidance was consumed; tool-call acceptance alone is insufficient proof of application
Steer preserves the same ExecutionBinding, attempt_no, control_epoch, and followup_count
focused correction targets the original native child identity and uses a changed correction basis rather than a fixed correction-count budget
continuation after interruption preserves the same ExecutionBinding identity
same-child correction and continuation do not create a fresh attempt
interrupt result alone does not release WriterLease
current-generation Host lifecycle evidence settles the execution
stale control or lease generation evidence cannot settle the writer
UNKNOWN or unsettled writer ownership blocks replacement and Main takeover
Main can acquire WriterLease only after current-generation Host settlement
single-writer invariant holds throughout takeover
root rollout evidence binds lifecycle call id child identity and result
allowlisted inspection omits assignment text and reasoning content
ambiguous or stale rollout evidence cannot authorize acceptance or writer transfer

required_probes.operation: final review and effective sandbox truth
requires: fresh Advisor review is bound to the exact candidate artifact
artifact mutation invalidates the prior review verdict
effective Advisor sandbox and permission state are Host-observed and satisfy the strict read-only Final Review boundary
requested profile sandbox and behavioral mutation authority are not promoted to effective Host proof
known broader Host permission behavior is disclosed as a release limitation when present

pass_policy: All N0-N8 probes must PASS in an external exact-candidate campaign whose environment identities and this contract digest are bound by release evidence. Repository CI and this Host campaign are separate release gates.
